models: Audi A3 / VW Golf / Seat Leon
Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Parking Light Status Lamp (in Instrument Cluster) stuck ON
Self Dimming Rear View Mirror not working
commonCauses: Light Switch (E1) faulty (or switched to an intermediate position)
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Light Switch (E1) faulty
stepByStepSolution:
Kontrol edin:  Light Switch (E1)
See Measuring Value Blocks (MVB)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Light Switch (E1)
technicalNotes:
When found in Audi A3/S3 (8P): Central Electronics, check Light Switch Status in Measuring Value Block (MVB) 017 and 018.
When found in Audi A4/S4/RS4/Cabriolet (8E/8H): Central Electronics, check Light Switch Status in Measuring Value Block (MVB) 006.1.
